no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

response: {"headline": "STABILITY trial of darapladib failed to reduce MACE in stable coronary heart disease (HR 0.94), consistent with a non-causal Lp-PLA2 target.", "summary": "The STABILITY trial randomized 15,828 patients with stable coronary heart disease to darapladib 160 mg or placebo, targeting a 15.5% relative risk reduction with 90% power and 1,500 planned primary endpoint events over a median 3.51 years follow-up. The trial did not meet its primary endpoint of cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, or nonfatal stroke (HR 0.94). Genetic evidence shows no causal link between PLA2G7 and coronary heart disease (Open Targets score 0.0), and the calculator predicts no benefit (expected HR 1.0, causal RRR 0%). Despite robust Lp-PLA2 inhibition of ~66% in phase 2, the biomarker reduction did not translate to clinical benefit. Safety was acceptable with no major imbalance in serious adverse events. Confidence in the failure assessment is high.", "key_evidence": ["15,828 participants randomized (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00799903 STABILITY)", "Primary endpoint: composite of CV death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke (Study design and rationale for the clinical outcomes of the STABILITY Trial)", "1,500 planned primary endpoint events (Study design and rationale for the clinical outcomes of the STABILITY Trial)", "90% power to detect 15.5% relative risk reduction (Study design and rationale for the clinical outcomes of the STABILITY Trial)", "Median follow-up 3.51 years (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00799903 STABILITY)", "Observed HR 0.94 for primary endpoint (GSK announces top-line results from pivotal Phase III study of darapladib in chronic coronary heart disease)", "Study did not meet the primary endpoint measure (GSK announces top-line results from pivotal Phase III study of darapladib in chronic coronary heart disease)", "Lp-PLA2 inhibition ~66% placebo-adjusted at phase 3 dose (Peripheral artery disease, biomarkers, and darapladib)", "Open Targets genetic association score for PLA2G7 is 0.0 (opentargets:PLA2G7)", "Calculator expected HR 1.0, causal RRR 0.0% (calculator)", "No major imbalance in serious adverse events (GSK announces top-line results from pivotal Phase III study of darapladib in chronic coronary heart disease)"], "what_would_change_this": "Mendelian randomization using loss-of-function variants in PLA2G7 demonstrating a causal effect of Lp-PLA2 inhibition on cardiovascular outcomes would be required to overturn the conclusion that the target is not causal.", "readthrough_note": "The sister trial SOLID-TIMI 52 in acute coronary syndrome also failed, reinforcing that Lp-PLA2 inhibition does not reduce cardiovascular events across different patient populations."}
